content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aircraft and engine trading, used parts and component repair; Gogo sells in-flight connectivity service and equipment, not aircraft trading."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Kansas casino management plus business jet modifications; no overlap with in-flight internet and connectivity service."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial IoT routers and cloud device management for utilities and enterprises; not aircraft connectivity service sold to airlines."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Terrestrial telecom and cable provider in Alaska selling wireless, broadband and TV to consumers; no in-flight business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Designs and certifies cockpit avionics like flight displays and autopilots; a hardware avionics maker, not connectivity service."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Telecom IP communications and session border controllers for carriers and enterprises; different products and customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Travel distribution and airline IT booking platforms earning booking fees; does not provide in-flight connectivity."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures business jets, military helicopters and golf vehicles; an aircraft OEM, not an in-flight connectivity provider."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Provides in-flight and aviation satellite broadband to airlines and sells terminals, the same connectivity service and hardware model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Network test instruments and optical components for telecom operators; equipment and software for network testing, not aircraft connectivity."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Leases and repairs aircraft engines to airlines; an aircraft asset lessor, not an in-flight connectivity service."}]}
